deviation: The draft removes Arcadia's audit right entirely, whereas the standard allows an annual audit on 14 days' notice and the fallback allows one every two years. Without it, Arcadia cannot verify the Supplier's compliance with the DPA, which is a data protection failure and a loss of a core right.
suggested_text: The Customer may audit the Supplier's records and facilities relevant to this DPA once per year on 14 days' notice.
